//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Better Beacon Placement -> Config

Enable Better Beacon Placement.//: Whether Better Beacon Placement is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart. Do not disable a mod that adds blocks or items to an existing world, they will be removed.

breakBeaconBaseBlocks.//: If enabled, drops all beacon base blocks when the beacon itself is broken.

dropReplacedBlockTopBeacon.//: If enabled, when a mineral block replaces a normal block that block is dropped on top of the beacon.
